tasks.final_text: I remember when I was just a small kid, my family and I went to a waterpark in the Philippines, and it was my first time ever riding a waterslide. My brothers somehow convinced me that the the waterslide at the top of this 7-slide structure would be the least scary. They lied.

Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.
